{{Quote|They were an almost universally beloved people.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to [[Talon Karrde]], about Caamas' inhabitants|<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
'''Caamas''' was a highly populated and marsh-covered [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] in the [[Cirius system/Legends|Cirius system]], the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Cirius]]. It was notable for the devastation it suffered during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] which destroyed its ecosystem and nearly wiped out the native [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]].

==Geographic features==
[[File:CaamasiJungle.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Caamasi Wildnerness.]]

Caamas was once a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]], hospitable world of [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], marshes, steppes, and rolling hills. Its dense [[Forest/Legends|rainforests]] and jungles teemed with life. After the Imperial bombardment, nearly all flora and fauna either disappeared or were mutated beyond recognition. Caamas became a barren waste, and without vegetation to release oxygen, the atmosphere became toxic and unbreathable. Bombardment kicked up smoke and dust into the air, and the surface became wracked by dust storms and falling soot, eroding the surface and sending dirt and mud into the oceans. The waters, once teeming with sea life, became muddy, polluted, stagnant, and lifeless.

==History==
===Pre-Republic era===
Caamas was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Behemoth (creature)|behemoths]] and the sentient [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] people. Around [[30,000 BBY]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]], Caamas was ruled by the space-faring [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. Using [[Force-drive|Force-based hyperdrives]], they traveled to many worlds around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that possessed significant signatures in the Force, uniting them to form the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. After five thousand years of galactic dominance, the Rakata retreated to their homeworld.<ref name="TEA" />

===Old Republic era===
[[File:Caamasi-NEGAS.png|thumb|left|150px|A [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]].]]
In [[25,053 BBY]], Caamas was one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Some legends claimed that the early [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] learned morality from the Caamasi, whose name came to mean 'friend from afar' or 'stranger to be trusted' in various languages used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Despite these legends, few Caamasi ever learned the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] under the Jedi. There was, however, a [[Caamas Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] established there for contemplation, learning, and teaching proper moral judgment, and at least one Caamasi did become a Jedi, [[Ylenic It'kla]], who served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

During the last stages of the [[Pius Dea Era]] in the [[11,100 BBY|11,100s BBY]], the Caamasi opposed the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[inquisition]]s against domestic opposition. They succeeded in persuading the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to end their centuries-long [[Recusal]] and collaborated with the Jedi and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakani]] to mastermind an anti-Pius Dea heresy which developed into the [[Renunciates]] movement by [[10,967 BBY]]. During the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]], the Caamasi were part of a broad anti-Pius Dea coalition which toppled the sect and ended its grip on the Republic. Following the [[Battle of Uquine]], the last Pius Dea [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex XIX]] was tried and imprisoned for life on Caamas.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Eeshrin Ot'Hyne]], who opposed the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. Despite this, Caamas remained loyal to the Republic during the Clone Wars that followed. Pacifistic by nature, the Caamasi found war distasteful, possessing a deep empathy and respect for other beings, including their enemies.<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_2.html|Point/Counterpoint: Military Creation Act}}</ref>

===Destruction===
{{Main|Caamas Firestorm}}
{{Quote|Mysterious Disaster Strikes Caamas|Newsreport on the incident|<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Caamas_TFUCG.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Caamasi Wilderness after the planet's devastation.]]
Although [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] appreciated the loyalty of Caamas, he found their adherence to the principles and values of the Old Republic intolerable. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had the planet subjected to a [[Caamas Firestorm|planetary bombardment]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after the powerful and heavily guarded [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] were infiltrated and lowered by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] agents. The Jedi Temple on Caamas was ruined, suffering many direct hits at Palpatine's direction. Many survivors fled to other worlds including, ironically, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was here that one of the largest communities of the [[Caamasi Remnant]] settled, hoping to find sanctuary, only to die when that planet too was destroyed by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. The [[Royal Library of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Library]] on Alderaan contained a great deal of information on the attack. In later years, other communities of Caamasi survivors were formed on [[Kerilt]] and [[Susevfi]].

Several years after the destruction of Caamas, a meteor hit the planet and carved a massive crater in its surface.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] led a mercy mission to Caamas.<ref name="TEA" />

===New Republic era===
Under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a few Caamasi founded [[Refuge City]] on Caamas, from which they hoped to decontaminate and rescue their blighted world. They were aided by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], who were naturally drawn to such projects, as they were with the reconstruction of [[Telos IV]] many centuries prior. Some of the Ithorians, however, arrived when their [[Unidentified Ithorian herdship|herdship]] crashed on Caamas under mysterious circumstances, and the xenological jungle it contained took root on Caamas' smallest continent in the southern hemisphere. The existence of this herdship was known only to a few Ithorians. The ruined Jedi Temple was located in this impenetrable alien jungle.<ref name="CATCW" />

Just south of [[Refuge City]] lay a crater that had been caused by a meteor strike shortly after the devastation. The Bothans paid Caamas 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a year to use this location as a waste dump. The funds went directly to decontamination efforts. It was virtually unknown that [[Bothan Debris, Incorporated]], who rented the location, was a front for the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], run by an agent named [[Kursk Te'tell]].<ref name="CATCW" />

====Caamas Document Crisis====
{{Quote|It does occur to me, though, that we might be worrying more than necessary about this whole Caamas thing. That was a long time ago, and it could be that no one will care anymore who was to blame.|[[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="Specter of the Past" />}}
In order to devastate the surface of Caamas, Palpatine had to ensure the planetary shield generators were deactivated. To that end, he hired a group of Bothan operatives, an action that did not come to light until the [[Caamas Document]] was uncovered from the remains of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], prompting a major [[Caamas Document Crisis|crisis]] in the New Republic. To add to the confusion, a copy of the document was altered shortly after its discovery by [[Grodin Tierce (clone)|Grodin Tierce]] to implicate Bothan clans who had had no involvement in the operation, a copy which was given to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] by a [[Flim (Human)|fake Grand Admiral Thrawn]].

[[File:BattleofCaamas.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The [[Battle of Caamas|end]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance.]]]]

===Later history===
{{Quote|&hellip;Coruscant can no longer be militarily defended. The Galactic Alliance must now surrender.|[[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] to [[Roan Fel]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 8">[[Legacy (2006) 8|''Legacy'' (2006) 8]]</ref>}}
In [[130 ABY]], it was the site of the [[Battle of Caamas|final battle]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. The [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] was militarily defeated by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The Galactic Alliance was dissolved and the [[Fel Empire|Empire]] was thus reestablished as the primary galactic government.
